tests.name: Google token supplier, flag wiring and voice-flag registry
tests.reason: The token exchange needs the Google-side binding of the ECS task role (owner step); no read-only HTTP probe on staging can show a token without exposing it. The suites pin the supplier, the signed AWS request built with no metadata call, the flag-gated orb-live path and the staging pin; the live proof is the staging log line 'access token prewarmed (auth=aws_supplier)' after the owner binds the role.
